The fast regression suite (23 suites) passes on the CI Linux resolve of the locked set.
The CI security job - which installs the locked set and then runs bandit, secret hygiene and 'pip-audit' - stays green, including pip-audit against the new pins.
The Docker image builds with the new COPY/RUN constraint wiring and its health check passes.
The integration job boots the full six-service compose stack from the pre-built image and verifies the audit chain.
